account:
Today I have been following my mayoral appointments: office business, a market walk, lunch at home, and town accounts. I checked the treasury and found 128 emeralds, leaving them untouched. I have now reached the east-bank dockside cottage for afternoon tea; the neighbour is standing nearby. I am late for the scheduled fifteen hundred visit, and should return to the office at sixteen thirty.

There are a few unusual things I do not yet understand. I heard the builder speaking and shouting around twelve forty-eight, but could not make out the words. Earlier the secretary said they had also heard the builder and Freight shouting without understanding them, and offered to inquire. I repeatedly asked for their report, but have not heard an intelligible answer. That leaves me with no reliable explanation of the shouting or the people’s intentions.

Townsfolk have reported the baker carrying wheat at the bakery and later a sack of bread at the inn and near the plaza. This may simply be bread production and deliveries; I have no evidence of anything improper. One report also repeated a shout from near the inn asking Freight to wait for a private word, but I do not know who said it or what they wanted to discuss. I noticed an oak-plank block appear in the town hall area at (-58, -60, 26), which might be building work, though I did not see who placed it or why. These events could be connected, but that is only a possibility. I should not treat overheard fragments or repeated reports as proof of a particular scheme.
